Definition: to lean idly, i.e. to be indolent or slack
BiblicalUsage: The Danites told their brothers not to be slothful, but to arise and go up against Laish, for the land was very good and God had given it into their hand. The word means to lean idly, to slacken when action is needed.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that sloth is not rest, it is a refusal to take what God has already given.
